research_question.title: Can the first-norm source tensors be compiled exactly without five-fold enumeration?

field_types: prime fields of characteristic greater than three
methods: exact tensor-train arithmetic over finite fields
streamed Hadamard products with exact rank factorization

research_question.motivation: EXP-ECDLP-TT-NORM-RANK-001 established a degree-preserving first norm, a five-dimensional trace-zero source span, and exact finite-registry rank profiles, but it obtained every tensor by enumerating B^5 tuples. A useful fixed-curve primitive requires constructing the source advice from the bound RCB circuit itself, with construction work and memory charged and without consulting the full tuple table.
research_question.decision_target: Decide whether a literal gatewise exact TT compiler can construct X^2, XZ, Z^2, YZ, and Y^2 for the frozen five-source RCB circuit without B^5 enumeration, preserve exact semantics under independent replay, and support charged target specialization; or isolate the first named gate, mode cut, and resource whose rank or work defeats this construction schedule.
constraints: The producer may iterate over physical modes, registries, TT bonds, circuit gates, and a fixed number of diagnostic tuples, but may not enumerate the Cartesian product of all five source modes.
The verifier must independently enumerate all B^5 toy tuples and charge that work only to verification, never to preprocessing advice.
All finite-field rank decisions are exact; floating-point SVD, thresholds, and approximate rounding are prohibited.
Every raw bond product, factorization matrix, transfer matrix, retained core, field operation, logical read and write, canonical byte, peak live word count, and peak RSS is reported.
Primary evidence uses only frozen random_unique and x_interval registries; consecutive-scalar, identity, planted, and synthetic tensors are controls.
A successful first-norm source compiler is not a zero locator, witness finder, relation generator, complete index-calculus algorithm, ECDLP solution, or rho exponent improvement.
